pipeline_grag_v2.answer:
To apply for the MS in Applied Data Science, you must submit the following materials:

- **Two letters of recommendation** [1]
- **Candidate statement** (max 700 words) [2]
- **Resume/CV** [3]
- **Programming supplement** (PDF, max 2 pages) [4]
- **Virtual portfolio** (recorded video responses to prompts) [5]
- **Proof of English language proficiency** (if applicable) [6]
- **Unofficial transcripts** from all previous colleges/universities (official transcripts required if admitted) [7][8]
- **$90 non-refundable application fee** [9]
